resolvedFindings.provenance: Old defect independently reproduced in Chrome and Playwright WebKit before repair, with matched raw fields and genuine native results.
resolvedFindings.impact: Nested focus-triggered handoff then actual Close, or a newer refused oversize handoff, was overwritten by the older outer action reopening stale alpha while header showed beta/invalid text.
resolvedFindings.repair: Per-handoff epoch invalidates older work even on newer refusal; exact field/raw/composition and owner checks surround close/mount/focus/open/search boundaries.
resolvedFindings.finalVerification: Plain nested valid handoff keeps beta; nested close/refusal remain closed with zero modal hits in both engines.

resolvedFindings.provenance: Independently reproduced old failure under controlled native capability removal and native showModal DOMException injection in both engines; not a claim that these installed browsers lack dialog support.
resolvedFindings.impact: Optional button emitted pageerrors and left false ready feedback on expanded-search failure.
resolvedFindings.repair: Local guarded failure recovery reports a readable larger-search failure, preserves owner/header/full-results, and permits retry when native capability recovers.
resolvedFindings.finalVerification: No pageerrors; actual native query remains usable, full route stays available, restored native API reopens exact alpha with the same owner, one disposal.

resolvedFindings.provenance: Old trusted native-pointer reproduction belongs to tests agent and parent, independently inspected here. This reviewer did not independently execute the old pointer reproducer; final native-link proof is independent.
resolvedFindings.impact: During genuine pointer input→owned anchor focus transition, native activeElement transiently became BODY. The queued blur check removed the anchor before pointerup/click, so result navigation failed. relatedTarget was the owned connected anchor.
resolvedFindings.repair: Honor connected same-document owned relatedTarget before fallback blur microtask; retain null/outside dismissal and window/document outside handling. No forced focus or click interception.
resolvedFindings.finalVerification: Both direct standalone dropdown and wrapper after a failed-load retry follow the actual /guide/alpha/ URL by trusted ordinary pointer click in both engines; no preventDefault or force-click workaround.
